stem: Five canopy RH sensors agree closely while one wall sensor near an air outlet reads much drier. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: The outlier requires placement/data-quality verification before it is treated as representative of the room
The whole room must be drier than the canopy sensors show
The wall sensor is definitely broken
Move all sensors to the wall
rationale: The outlier requires placement/data-quality verification before it is treated as representative of the room. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
